comments.author: Igor Levicki
comments.content:
>>Alternatively, the player could just do something else
>>if they type another command or interact with a different object
>>the menu slides away and the game continues.

And what would be the result the script receives in that case?

It also seems like a problem because then you cannot force the player to make a choice.

comments.author: Alex Warren
comments.content:
If the user doesn't make a selection, the script won't run at all.

If you want to force the user to make a choice, you can still use the old "show menu" script command to show a pop-up dialog.
